status: prepared: acceptance criteria declared before any pilot run; not commissioned (no persistent host authorised - operator decision, Oct 2026)

scope.excluded: Hyperliquid books (pushes every ~5 s; not second-scale)

evidence_target: at least 20 eligible shock windows (E1 design trigger) with complete 30-minute history and recovery windows, OR the 14 days, whichever first; zero eligible shocks = inconclusive, never pass

resources.object_store: S3-compatible bucket named in stream/config (operator-provided credentials)

stop_conditions: raw bytes per day above the budget for 2 consecutive days
eligible-second share below 0.80 for any 24 h
upload verification failures on 3 consecutive partitions
replay: every closed partition uploaded, size-verified and listed in manifest/ with sha256; stream/pilot_acceptance.py re-reads and re-hashes them

verdict_rules.pass: all completeness rules met on every scoped book over the window AND evidence target reached
verdict_rules.fail: any completeness rule missed on a full day, or a stop condition
verdict_rules.inconclusive: rules met but fewer eligible shocks than the target

structured.note: machine-readable forms of the declared rules above (added repo 2.30; the declared values are unchanged)
structured.window: start_utc/end_utc declared when the pilot is commissioned; none yet (not commissioned)
structured.clock_evidence: derived/clock samples (recorder stream-1.1, Deribit public/get_time) at least hourly
